The Disappearing {{tt|Sōdo|Henry}}'') is the 30th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{Henry}}, {{p|Eternatus}}, {{p|Zacian}}, and {{p|Zamazenta}} disappear. * The [[Rusted Sword]] and [[Rusted Shield|Shield]] disappear. * [[Leon]] and the [[Gym Leader]]s are knocked unconscious by Eternatus's poison. * The [[Darkest Day]] ends. * [[Oleana]] plans to contact a {{adv|Moon|poison expert}} to find an antidote for Eternatus's poison. * {{Casey}} tracks Henry's location to either the [[Isle of Armor]] or the [[Crown Tundra]]. * [[Rose]] resigns as chairman and is arrested. * Casey, [[Hop]], [[Marnie]], and [[Bede]] decide to search for for Henry and the Rusted Sword and Shield. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Henry Sword|Henry]] * [[Casey Shield|Casey]] * [[Professor Magnolia]] * [[Hop]] * [[Bede]] * [[Marnie]] * [[Sonia]] * [[Milo]] * [[Nessa]] * [[Kabu]] * [[Bea]] * [[Allister]] * [[Opal]] * [[Gordie]] * [[Melony]] * [[Piers]] * [[Raihan]] * [[Leon]] * [[Klara]] (silhouette) * [[Oleana]] * [[Rose]] * [[Sordward]] (flashback) * [[Shielbert]] (flashback) * [[Marvin]] * [[Ball Guy]] * {{tc|Macro Cosmos's}} (multiple) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]];
